article.title: Salesforce’s M&A spree continues with a reported $375M deal for defense tech startup Rune
article.summary: The AI logistics startup will bolster the CRM giant's Missionforce defense platform.
article.content: The AI logistics startup will bolster the CRM giant's Missionforce defense platform.
article.aiArticle:
Customer relationship management giant Salesforce is reportedly pressing forward with its active acquisition strategy by targeting the defense technology sector. According to [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/30/salesforces-ma-spree-continues-with-a-reported-375m-deal-for-defense-tech-startup-rune/), the enterprise software leader has agreed to purchase artificial intelligence logistics startup Rune for approximately **$375 million**. 

## Bolstering the Missionforce Defense Platform

The reported transaction is designed to directly strengthen Salesforce's existing Missionforce defense platform, as detailed by the source report. Rune specializes in artificial intelligence-driven logistics solutions tailored for military and defense applications. By absorbing the startup, the CRM titan aims to expand its operational footprint within the lucrative and specialized defense tech market. Financial analysts often track enterprise software spending closely, much like how observers monitor shifts in [Amazon reported booming cloud revenue but otherwise missed expectations](https://new-sfeed.lovable.app/en/articles/amazon-reported-booming-cloud-revenue-but-otherwise-missed-expectations) to gauge broader technology sector health. 

## The Stakes for Enterprise Software Giants

*Context:* Major technology providers have increasingly targeted specialized artificial intelligence startups to diversify their revenue streams beyond traditional commercial software. Deals of this magnitude highlight how enterprise firms are willing to invest heavily to secure proprietary AI logistics and operational tooling. This acquisition trend reflects a broader push by silicon valley conglomerates to integrate themselves into government contracting and national security infrastructure, creating new compliance and operational dynamics for legacy tech players. 

## What to Watch

Industry observers will be tracking official confirmation from both companies regarding the final terms and timeline of the acquisition. Further developments are expected to reveal how deeply Rune's artificial intelligence logistics tools will be integrated into Salesforce's existing product architecture, alongside any potential regulatory hurdles that might accompany a major defense tech transaction.

Sources: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/30/salesforces-ma-spree-continues-with-a-reported-375m-deal-for-defense-tech-startup-rune/)
